cohort.0: The study included 50 pregnancies identified from medical records (2006-2018) that started as multiple gestations but continued as singletons.

finding.0: Pregnancies that started as multiple gestations but continued as singletons had a significantly increased risk of Vasa Previa (OR 41.1, 95% CI 12.77-131.94) compared to multiple pregnancies.
